# BuildCalc Pro — Construction Estimator & Contractor PDF Quote Suite

> Free, 100% client-side feet-inches-fraction trade calculators (Concrete, Framing, Roofing, Drywall, Stairs, Decking, Paint, Tile) with instant client PDF estimate and invoice generation.

## Core Capabilities
- Native Feet, Inches & Tape-Measure Fraction input (`14' 6-3/8"`)
- 8 specialized trade material & labor calculators with configurable waste %, markup %, and tax %
- Instant print-ready PDF Estimate, Proposal, Change Order & Invoice generator with customer signature blocks

## Calculators & Templates
- [BuildCalc Pro — Free Construction Calculator & Contractor Estimate PDF Maker](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/index.html): Calculate concrete, framing studs, roof pitch & shingles, drywall, stairs, decking, paint, and tile in feet-inches-fractions. Generate branded client PDF estimates in 60 seconds.
- [Concrete Slab & Cubic Yard Calculator (Feet, Inches & 80lb Bags)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/concrete-slab-calculator.html): Free concrete slab calculator for contractors. Calculate exact cubic yards, 80lb & 60lb premix bags, rebar grid, and generate a client concrete estimate PDF.
- [Concrete Footing & Foundation Volume Calculator (Cu Yd + Cost)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/concrete-footing-calculator.html): Calculate continuous wall footings, foundation trenches, ready-mix cubic yards, and labor costs with instant PDF quote export.
- [Sonotube & Cylindrical Concrete Pier Calculator (Bags & Yards)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/sonotube-concrete-calculator.html): Calculate concrete bags and cubic yards for deck piers, post holes, and Sonotube forms with contractor waste factor.
- [Concrete Driveway Cost & Yardage Estimator (2026 Contractor Pricing)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/concrete-driveway-cost-calculator.html): Estimate concrete driveway yardage, rebar mesh, forming labor, and total price per square foot with instant client proposal PDF.
- [Stamped & Brushed Concrete Patio Calculator + Quote Template](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/concrete-patio-calculator.html): Calculate concrete patio yardage, thickness, bags, and finishing labor per square foot.
- [Wall Framing Stud & Sheathing Calculator (16" & 24" OC)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/framing-stud-calculator.html): Calculate wall studs, top and bottom plates, king/jack studs for windows and doors, and 4x8 OSB sheathing sheets in feet and inches.
- [Basement Wall Framing & Lumber Estimator (Studs + Treated Plates)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/basement-framing-calculator.html): Estimate lumber, pressure-treated sill plates, studs, and labor cost for framing basement walls.
- [Garage Framing Material & Lumber List Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/garage-framing-material-calculator.html): Generate a complete garage framing lumber takeoff and client quote PDF in under 60 seconds.
- [4x8 Plywood & OSB Wall/Roof Sheathing Sheet Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/sheathing-plywood-osb-calculator.html): Calculate exact 4x8 OSB and plywood sheets needed for walls, subfloors, and roofs including waste factor.
- [Roof Pitch, Multiplier & Rafter Slope Calculator (X/12 Pitch)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/roof-pitch-calculator.html): Convert flat building footprint to actual roof area using exact X/12 roof pitch multipliers. Calculate squares and bundles.
- [Roofing Squares & Shingle Bundle Calculator (+ Hip/Valley Waste)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/roof-shingle-bundle-calculator.html): Calculate roofing squares, architectural shingle bundles, synthetic underlayment rolls, ridge cap, and tear-off labor.
- [Standing Seam & Corrugated Metal Roof Estimator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/metal-roofing-cost-calculator.html): Estimate metal roofing panels, squares, trim, underlayment, and installation cost per square.
- [TPO, EPDM & Modified Bitumen Flat Roof Material Estimator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/flat-roof-membrane-calculator.html): Calculate commercial and residential flat roof squares, membrane rolls, insulation boards, and labor.
- [Drywall Sheet, Joint Compound & Tape Calculator (4x8 & 4x12)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/drywall-sheet-calculator.html): Calculate 4x8 and 4x12 drywall sheets, 5-gallon mud buckets, drywall screws, and tape rolls for walls and ceilings.
- [Drywall Hanging, Taping & Level 4/5 Finishing Cost Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/drywall-finishing-cost-estimator.html): Estimate drywall labor and material pricing per sheet or per square foot with instant contractor bid PDF.
- [Stair Stringer, Rise & Run Calculator (IRC R311.7 Code Check)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/stair-stringer-calculator.html): Calculate exact stair riser height, number of treads, total horizontal run, and 2x12 stringer length with automatic IRC building code verification.
- [Exterior Deck Stair Stringer & Tread Material Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/deck-stair-calculator.html): Calculate pressure-treated stair stringers, tread boards, and rise/run geometry for exterior decks.
- [Decking Board, Joist & Fastener Calculator (Composite & Wood)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/deck-material-calculator.html): Calculate 16-ft deck boards, linear footage, 16" OC substructure joists, joist hangers, and hidden fasteners.
- [Hardwood & Dimensional Lumber Board-Foot Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/lumber-board-foot-calculator.html): Calculate board feet, linear feet, and lumber package costs for rough and finish carpentry.
- [Composite Deck Material & Labor Cost Estimator (Trex / TimberTech)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/composite-deck-cost-estimator.html): Estimate composite decking boards, hidden clips, framing lumber, and labor per square foot.
- [Wood Privacy Fence Post, Rail & Picket Material Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/fence-picket-post-calculator.html): Estimate 4x4 fence posts, 2x4 rails, pickets, concrete bags, and installation labor.
- [Interior & Exterior Paint + Primer Gallon Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/paint-gallon-calculator.html): Calculate exact gallons and 5-gallon buckets of finish paint and primer by square footage and number of coats.
- [Commercial & Residential Painting Bid Estimator + PDF Proposal](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/house-painting-bid-calculator.html): Price interior and exterior painting jobs per square foot including prep, masking, primer, and 2-coat finish.
- [Garage Floor Epoxy Coating & Flake Coverage Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/epoxy-garage-floor-calculator.html): Calculate epoxy resin kits, primer, polyaspartic topcoat, and labor for garage floor coatings.
- [Tile, Thinset Mortar, Backer Board & Grout Calculator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/tile-flooring-calculator.html): Calculate floor and shower wall tile counts, 50lb thinset bags, cement backer boards, and grout with diagonal waste options.
- [Bathroom & Walk-In Shower Tile + Waterproofing Estimator](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/shower-tile-waterproofing-calculator.html): Estimate shower wall and pan tiles, Kerdi/cement board, thinset mortar, and tile setter labor.
- [LVP, Laminate & Hardwood Flooring Box Calculator (+ Waste %)](https://buildcalcpro.github.io/lvp-hardwood-flooring-calculator.html): Calculate flooring square footage, boxes required, underlayment, transition strips, and installation cost.
